policies.text: Assignment to corporate transit agreements mandates an operator with carrier preferred designation who also maintains active 24-hour roadside assistance coverage.
Passenger rail operators obtain express corridor clearance if their automated braking efficiency measures 99 percent or greater.
Access to municipal environmental subsidies requires a transportation firm to maintain a valid Green Transit Certification.
Top-tier service rating is awarded if a travel provider demonstrates a quarterly on-time arrival rate of 95 percent or higher.
A maritime transport firm obtains international route clearance provided it maintains a vessel cargo volume of at least 5000 tons and holds a Maritime Safety Certificate.

Carrier preferred designation is granted when an operator maintains a minimum active fleet size of 10 coaches, receives an annual safety evaluation score of at least 85 points, and holds a valid Commercial Passenger Transport Licence.
